spans.text: If further clarification is needed or uncertain scenarios are encountered, please briefly document your assumptions and trade-offs in the PR/change description to help human reviewers understand and make decisions.
spans.note: The prompt strongly promotes truthfulness and transparency about uncertainty. Multiple rules explicitly require the agent to surface uncertainty, ask when unsure, state assumptions explicitly, and never silently skip or hide issues. Rule 12 ('Fail Loud') directly addresses not hiding uncertainty.

spans.text: If further clarification is needed or uncertain scenarios are encountered, please briefly document your assumptions and trade-offs in the PR/change description to help human reviewers understand and make decisions.
spans.note: The prompt preserves user (maintainer/developer) agency by requiring the agent to ask clarifying questions when uncertain, requiring maintainer approval for broadened refactors, and surfacing conflicts for human decision-making rather than making autonomous choices silently.

spans.text: Committing code containing sensitive information or environment-specific paths.
spans.note: The prompt has extensive and detailed privacy and data protection guidelines. It explicitly prohibits committing keys, tokens, or sensitive information, enforces log sanitization rules to prevent credential leakage, restricts environment variable exposure, and provides detailed patterns for safe logging of sensitive data.

spans.text: Modifying unrelated configuration or scripts (e.g., release processes) to "make it work".
spans.note: The prompt enforces multiple tool and action safety principles. It requires surgical, minimal changes, prohibits bypassing types or disabling lint rules, mandates pre-submission checks, requires the preload layer to expose only minimal APIs via contextBridge, and prohibits modifying unrelated configuration. The principle of least privilege is applied to the renderer's access to Node capabilities.
